WITH color_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color') AS color,
    SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS total_invoiced
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color')
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(total_invoiced) AS grand_total, 
    COUNT(*) AS color_count
  FROM color_totals
),
color_with_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ct.color,
    ct.total_invoiced,
    ct.total_invoiced / gt.grand_total AS share,
    gt.grand_total / gt.color_count AS avg_per_color,
    ct.total_invoiced - (gt.grand_total / gt.color_count) AS above_average
  FROM color_totals ct
  CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
),
above_average_colors AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM color_with_stats
  WHERE total_invoiced > avg_per_color
)
SELECT 
  AVG(total_invoiced) AS avg_invoiced_amount,
  AVG(share) AS avg_share,
  AVG(above_average) AS avg_above_average
FROM above_average_colors
